input: Find churches that hold Vacation Bible School (VBS) for kids in Haywood, Jackson and Swain counties, NC (Waynesville, Canton, Sylva, Cherokee). Search "vacation bible school" and "VBS" with town names (no year), and list every church you find with its town.
searches: Silvermine Missionary Baptist Church Bryson City facebook
